information: All candidates use identical complete public training streams/grouping, masked two/three/four-token raw prefixes, aliases and at most one actual indexed READ. No supplied family identity, hidden values or owner target enters decisions. Full prefix and static timing: no restricted streaming or continuous neural claim.
selection: Independent mixed-population .99higher OOD surprise cutoff. Threshold candidates fixed .85/.95/.99. For every model/threshold/threecalibrationstrata compute overall and fractional CP bounds at delta=.05/(3models*3thresholds*3strata*2risks). Require ALLstrata bounds<=.10 and>=20fractional answers perstratum. Select largest total fractional acceptance then lowest threshold. Nonepassing=>nearpointmass fallback and failed calibration; never qualifies via all-abstention.
calibration_labels: Owner family stratum is used only for stratified risk verification, never exposed as model input or used to select actions/READs. Original R19 failures motivate these declared calibration populations.
shift_scope: relabeled_lag2 uses unseen conjugate4cycles excluding original+1; it tests explicitly assumed label-transport symmetry, not an unanticipated structural law. lag2_skip is the untouched two2cycle lag-two +2 law, outside training and calibration; its structural shift gate stays separate.
confirmation: Every panel512independent generators*4dependent worlds, seed2005513,4096paired generator-bootstrap draws. Zero accepted denominator=>risk1. Report perpanel nominal95%bounds, not simultaneous finite-sample coverage. Do not pool panels or R19/development/replays.
gate: Perpanel no invalidity/supportloss, frozen stratified calibration passes,>=32fractional accepted, upper95fractional AND overall risk<=.10. Fresh reversal and lag-two gates are explicit primary repair conditions. Relabel transport and newstructural shift gates reported separately; conjunction does not imply arbitraryunknownlaw robustness.
utility: Correct+1,incorrect-1,abstain0,minus actual oneREAD fee from .02/.12/.3/.6. Same-information Brier BEFORE any purchased token; actual utility uses own executed actions and receipts.
nonidentifiability: Provide explicit four-world same-public-prefix ambiguity construction: oneREAD may reveal a nonquery write, leaving two different targets with identical observable transcript. No universal90%uncertain-answer guarantee over unrestricted laws follows from finite calibration.
freeze: Publish exact sources/dependencies before prepare, then exact fitted models/cutoffs/calibration/freeze before any fresh confirmation. No post-confirmation model/threshold/sample repair.
scope: Ordinary finite reference development only. Original10%risk and nontrivialuncertainty gates retained. No analytic-coreD-B,realAV,production,GPU/energy or complete lifecycle cost adoption claim. Allattempt costs and failures preserved.
